topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: The path through the trees shifts, the air carrying whispers of change. The familiar space where I used to find my daily sustenance now holds different scents, different movements. Another has taken the old route, the one that was once mine. I move with ease, finding my rhythm in the new trail, the one less known but no less promising. The forest, in its vast embrace, offers many paths. I sense no loss, only the fluidity of life reshaping itself around me. The sun filters through the leaves as it always has, and I continue on, as the world around me does the same.
